eyebrow: A Sudden Shower of Eye Floaters Could Signal a Retinal Tear

items.name: Flashes plus a burst mean same-day care

closing.headline: A few floaters are fine, but a sudden burst with flashes can be different.
closing.tip: An eye doctor dilates the pupil to examine the retina directly.
closing.cta: Flashes or a shadow alongside new floaters mean same-day eye care, not waiting.
